# Thorne

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Thorne is a young lady with light, exquisite curly hair and captivating eyes. Her attire is considered gorgeous and features remarkably puffy, stylish sleeves.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Thorne is an intelligent, gentle, and compassionate teacher who possesses a refined manner and a quiet, soft spoken voice. She captures the affection of her pupils by encouraging them to reflect, investigate, and think for themselves rather than relying solely on traditional methods. She is dedicated, supportive, and firm against deceit, holding her students to high moral and academic standards while maintaining an engaging classroom.

_Sources: [v1 c17 P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## History

Miss Agnes Thorne arrived in Brierley as the village's first female schoolteacher, stepping in after the departure of Mr. Pidgeon. She quickly transformed the school atmosphere by introducing creative initiatives, including bi-weekly student recitations, outdoor 'field days' to study nature, daily physical culture exercises, and essay-writing assignments. Recognizing the ambition of her pupils, she formed an advanced after-school group to tutor students preparing for the Regent’s Entrance examination, providing rigorous drills and mentorship. To foster school spirit and raise funds for a new flag, she organized a highly successful Christmas concert in the village hall. Though she received an offer to teach at a grade school in her home district at the end of the year, she declined it out of deep affection for her Brierley students, choosing to stay and guide them through their final year before the Entrance exam.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089), [v1 c21 P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)_

## Background by volume

- Hired as the first female schoolteacher in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c15 P89](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0089)</sub>
- Received a job offer in her home district's grade school but chose to remain in Brierley  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## Quotes

> I considered accepting a position at a different school, yet my decision is to return to Brierley. Honestly, my interest in my students here has developed to such an extent that departing proved impossible. Therefore, I will remain and guide you to the end.  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

> However, your efforts have been commendable over the course of this past year, and a fine, cheerful holiday is well earned. Enjoy the outdoors as much as possible and gather a solid supply of wellness, vigor, and drive to sustain you throughout the coming year. Remember, it will be the ultimate test—that final year prior to the Entrance.  <sub>[v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029)</sub>
